MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition+contamination+access. Coating tasks use QT+access. Height and texture are shared across both pools.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.00) x smoke(1.50) x obstructed_heavy(1.30) x H4(2.00) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 9.75x
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT5(1.50) x obstructed_heavy(1.30) x H4(2.00) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 4.88x
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.resolution: STACKING PARTITION — prep pool and coating pool never overlap. Extreme combos flagged for estimator review.

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x contamination x access x height x texture)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x height x texture)

task_production_rates.name: Move and Center-Pile Furniture
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Per-room fixed time. Move furniture to center, clear walls of hanging items. RP-new task — no NC equivalent. Rate derived from industry standard 8-15 min per room depending on furnishing density.

task_production_rates.name: Cover Center-Piled Furniture with Poly Sheeting
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Cover center-piled furniture with 2-4 mil poly sheeting, tape edges to floor. RP-new task. Faster than furniture move — just draping and taping.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup (Perimeter — Roll Method)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_FLOOR_PROTECT_PERIMETER_SETUP (600 SF/hr). Canvas drop cloths along wall perimeter.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup (Full Room — Spray Methods)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_FLOOR_PROTECT_SETUP (400 SF/hr). Full room coverage with rosin paper or plastic, taped seams.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Baseboard Top Edge
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_MASK_TRIM_BASEBOARD (200 LF/hr). RP always has trim in place — mandatory task. Standard blue tape QT2-QT3, green edge-seal QT4+.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Door Casing Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_MASK_TRIM_DOOR_CASING (180 LF/hr). Slightly slower than baseboard due to vertical orientation and corners.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Window Casing Edges
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_MASK_TRIM_WINDOW_CASING (180 LF/hr). Same rate as door casing masking.

task_production_rates.name: Cover Fixtures for Spray / Premium Roll
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_FIXTURE_COVERS_SETUP (15 EA/hr). ~4 min per room, ~6 fixtures/room.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Scan — All Walls

QT2.notes: Quick visual scan, major issues only

QT3.notes: Standard visual with work light, document all defects

QT4.notes: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph defect areas

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, multiple passes, full photo documentation

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Per-room fixed time varying by QT. Exterior RP analog TSK_TRRP_ASSESS_CONDITION at 6-10 min for trim; walls are larger surface = longer assessment. Industry standard 10-25 min per room depending on tier.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. ASTM D3359 cross-hatch tape test at 2+ locations per room. ~4 min per test site. Determines adhesion primer need.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Meter Evaluation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Pin-type or pinless moisture meter at suspect areas. Quick pass unless active moisture found (stop-work condition). 3-10 min per room.

task_production_rates.name: Coating Identification — Latex vs Oil
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Solvent test with mineral spirits to determine latex vs oil. 1-2 test areas per room. Quick test — results drive primer compatibility.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module task. XRF preferred (instant result), swab test acceptable (30 sec develop). 2+ locations per room. 5-15 min per room including documentation.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module task. Poly sheeting on floors and openings, warning signs, restrict access. EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. 20-45 min per room depending on room size and openings.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module task. HEPA vacuum all surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance. Required by EPA RRP Rule. Runs after each disturbance event.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Removal and Visual Clearance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module task. Remove containment poly, visual clearance inspection, no visible dust or debris. Faster than setup.

task_production_rates.name: Lead-Contaminated Waste Disposal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module task. Package and dispose lead-contaminated debris per EPA RRP Rule. Per-job fixed time. Transport to approved facility.

task_production_rates.name: TSP Wash for Surface Contamination

QT2.notes: Single pass with TSP solution, rinse

QT4.notes: Systematic wash with rinse verification, work light check

QT5.notes: Multiple passes as needed until clean, full verification

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. 200-300 SF/hr depending on contamination severity. Prep pool modifiers apply. Smoke is slowest (requires stronger solution, more scrubbing). Grease is fastest (TSP cuts grease quickly).

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Biocide Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Apply bleach/mildewcide solution, allow contact/kill time, rinse. 150-250 SF/hr includes dwell time. Source moisture must already be resolved.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Loose and Failing Paint

QT3.notes: Remove all failing paint, thorough scrape

QT4.notes: Comprehensive scrape with careful edge work

QT5.notes: Critical scrape — near-zero tolerance for remaining loose material

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Wide rate range: 50-120 SF/hr heavily condition-dependent. POOR condition with multiple layers of failing paint at 50 SF/hr. FAIR with localized peeling at 100+ SF/hr. Exterior RP analog SF_SIDING_WOOD scrape at 40-80 SF/hr — interior drywall is faster (less adhesion, thinner coatings).

task_production_rates.name: Feather-Sand Scrape Edges

QT3.notes: Smooth transition, no visible ridge at 6 ft

QT4.notes: Near-invisible transition, no ridge at 3 ft

QT5.notes: Perfect transition, no ridge at arm's length

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Feather-sand all scrape edges with 120-150 grit. Rate about 50% faster than scrape — working only edges, not full surface. 80-160 SF/hr. Non-negotiable at all tiers.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss Existing Paint Surface

QT4.notes: Full degloss with adhesion verification

QT5.notes: Complete degloss with bonding verification and spot re-test

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Chemical degloss (liquid sander wipe-on) or mechanical scuff (120-150 grit). ~80% of NC bare-wood sand rate (NC TSK_WALL_VACUUM_DUST at 800 SF/hr is different task; degloss is more intensive). Texture affects rate — more surface area to address.

task_production_rates.name: Fill Wall Defects — Spackle

QT3.notes: Fill all visible defects, reasonable feathering

QT4.notes: Fill all defects with careful feathering, invisible repairs

QT5.notes: Near-zero defect tolerance, wide feathering, multiple thin coats

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC finish TSK_SPACKLE_WALL_DEFECTS (1000 SF/hr at QT3). RP has higher defect density from scraping/condition damage — base rate reduced ~20%. POOR condition doubles effective time via condition modifier.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Spackled Areas

QT3.notes: Sand and blend, repair should not telegraph

QT4.notes: Sand perfectly smooth, repair invisible

QT5.notes: Sand to perfection, wet sponge test

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC finish TSK_SAND_SPACKLE_WALL (1200 SF/hr at QT3). RP has more spackled areas (scrape transitions, condition-driven damage) — base rate reduced ~17%. Condition modifier drives time variation.

task_production_rates.name: Assess and Replace Failed Caulk

QT4.notes: Comprehensive assessment, replace all suspect joints

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, replace all imperfect joints

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED — ~60% of NC full-caulk rate (~100 LF/hr for new caulk). RP is selective assess-and-replace: inspect joint, cut out failed sections, re-caulk. Slower per LF but fewer LF addressed. Condition modifier captures how much caulk is failed.

task_production_rates.name: Dust Wipe Wall Surfaces
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_DUST_WIPE_WALL (1000 SF/hr). Damp cloth or tack cloth wipe to remove prep dust. Same task regardless of NC or RP context.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Wall and Floor Dust After Prep
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_VACUUM_DUST (800 SF/hr). HEPA vacuum wall surfaces and floor to remove all prep dust before coating.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Primer at Ceiling Line

QT4.notes: Crisp edge with minimal brush marks

QT5.notes: Perfect edge, straight line

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_CUT_IN_CEILING (100 LF/hr QT3). Skip for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT. Freehand cut-in — do NOT mask drywall ceilings.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Wall

QT4.notes: Premium roll primer, uniform mil thickness

QT5.notes: Critical primer application, perfect coverage

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC prime TSK_WALL_ROLL_PRIMER (350 SF/hr). RP adhesion primer is slightly slower — higher viscosity, more careful application over mixed substrates. ~93% of NC rate. Skip for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Wall

QT2.notes: Standard spray primer — capped at backroll rate

QT3.notes: Thorough spray primer — capped at backroll rate

QT4.notes: Premium spray primer, consistent mil thickness

QT5.notes: Critical spray application

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC prime TSK_WALL_SPRAY_PRIMER (600 SF/hr). Reduced to 380 SF/hr to comply with spray/backroll coupling constraint: spray rate MUST BE <= backroll rate (400 SF/hr). QA-002 fix. Spray directly into wall-to-ceiling corner (no cut-in needed). Skip for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_BACKROLL_PRIMER (400 SF/hr). Binary task — backroll technique is identical regardless of primer type. MANDATORY for primer on previously painted surfaces. Skip for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Scraped/Repaired Areas

QT3.notes: Spot prime all spackled and scraped areas

QT4.notes: Spot prime all repairs with feathered edges

QT5.notes: Spot prime all repairs with wide feather

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC finish TSK_SPOT_PRIME_WALL (1800 SF/hr). Rate is per total wall SF (fast — only touching localized areas). RP has more spots to prime (scrape transitions, condition damage) so base rate reduced ~17%. Condition modifier captures spot density.

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Between Coats
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_LIGHT_SAND_BETWEEN_COATS_WALL (600 SF/hr QT4). 220 grit pole sander to smooth nibs. Coating pool — QT drives activation, not rate.

task_production_rates.name: Light Sand Between Coats (Critical)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_LIGHT_SAND_BETWEEN_COATS_WALL_QT5 (420 SF/hr). Careful sanding with raking light inspection. Critical for satin/semi-gloss.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_VACUUM_INTERCOAT_DUST_WALL (750 SF/hr). HEPA vacuum with brush attachment.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Between Coats

QT3.notes: Standard visual inspection, note obvious defects

QT4.notes: Systematic inspection with work light

QT5.notes: Critical inspection with raking light, multiple passes

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish inspection rates. QT3=1500 (NC TSK_INSPECT_PRIMED_WALL), QT4=1000 (NC QT4 variant), QT5=600 (NC QT5 variant). Coating pool — QT drives thoroughness.

task_production_rates.name: Patch Interstage Defects

QT4.notes: Repair all identified defects

QT5.notes: Repair all defects with wide feathering, near-zero tolerance

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Rate per total wall SF (fast — only patching localized defects found during inspection). Higher rate than initial spackle because defect density is much lower after prime/first coat. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Coat Patched Areas

QT4.notes: Spot coat all patches with feathered edges

QT5.notes: Spot coat all repairs with wide blend zone

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Rate per total wall SF. Very fast — touching only patched areas to equalize absorption. Similar to spot prime rate pattern. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line (Finish Coat 1)

QT2.notes: Acceptable if neat, minor wobble tolerated

QT4.notes: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 ft

QT5.notes: Crisp line, no visible wobble at arm's length

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_CEILING (130 LF/hr QT2, 100 QT3, 80 QT4, 60 QT5). Coating pool. Freehand cut-in identical once surface is prepped.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Wall at Ceiling Line (Finish Coat 2)

QT4.notes: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 ft

QT5.notes: Crisp line, perfect match to first coat

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_CEILING_R2 (100 QT3, 80 QT4, 60 QT5). Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Tape Lines (Coat 1)

QT4.notes: Precise cut to tape line

QT5.notes: Perfect cut to tape line

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_TRIM_R1 (150 QT2, 120 QT3, 100 QT4, 80 QT5). Coating pool. Cut into tape edge for clean reveal.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Wall at Trim Tape Lines (Coat 2)

QT4.notes: Precise cut to tape line

QT5.notes: Perfect cut to tape line

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_TRIM_R2 (120 QT3, 100 QT4, 80 QT5). Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_ROLL_WALL_FINISH_R1 (340 SF/hr smooth). Binary task — application rate is constant across QT. Texture modifier handles surface variation. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Wall Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_ROLL_WALL_FINISH_R2 (380 SF/hr). Second coat ~12% faster than first. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_SPRAY_WALL_FINISH_R1 (390 SF/hr). Coupled to backroll rate per doctrine — spray rate <= backroll rate. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_BACKROLL_WALL_FINISH_R1 (390 SF/hr). THIS IS THE BOTTLENECK — backroller sets pace. 18-inch roller. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Wall Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_SPRAY_WALL_FINISH_R2 (420 SF/hr). Second coat faster per COAT_FINISH_2 modifier. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Wall Finish Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_BACKROLL_WALL_FINISH_R2 (420 SF/hr). Second backroll coat faster per COAT_FINISH_2 modifier (0.90). Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Trim Masking Tape
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_REMOVE_TRIM_MASKING (400 LF/hr). Pull at angle for clean release. This spec installed the tape, this spec removes it.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_FIXTURE_COVERS_TEARDOWN (25 EA/hr). Faster than setup.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Blended rate from NC prime teardown rates. Perimeter teardown NC=900 SF/hr, full teardown NC=600 SF/hr. Blended at 700 SF/hr since RP teardown covers both floor types (method-dependent setup, unified teardown). Fold toward center to contain debris.

task_production_rates.name: Replace Furniture to Original Positions
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Slightly slower than furniture move — includes removing poly covers, checking for paint damage, verifying original positions. 10-20 min per room.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Floors
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC finish TSK_VACUUM_SUBFLOOR_POST_WALL (1500 SF/hr). Shop vacuum to remove paint drips, overspray debris, sanding dust.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC prime TSK_WALL_CLEAN_TOOLS (20 min). RP adds 5 min for shellac stain-blocker cleanup (denatured alcohol) when smoke damage primer used. Base 25 min covers worst case.

task_production_rates.name: Final Wall Inspection

QT2.notes: Quick visual for major misses, ambient light — capped at 2000 SF/hr guideline (QA-003 fix)

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC prime TSK_WALL_FINAL_INSPECT (2000 SF/hr). Walking inspection of completed walls. QT2/QT3 variant.

task_production_rates.name: Final Wall Inspection (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Transfer from NC finish inspection QT4 pattern (1000 SF/hr). Detailed inspection with work light at 3 ft distance.

task_production_rates.name: Final Wall Inspection (Critical)

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Defects Found During Inspection

QT2.notes: Address major misses only — capped at 2000 SF/hr guideline (QA-004 fix)

QT4.notes: Meticulous touch-up, blend into surrounding finish

QT5.notes: Critical touch-up, perfect blend, no visible repair

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Rate per total wall SF (fast — touching only localized defects). QT5 is slowest — perfect blend required, no visible repair allowed. Coating pool.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-new task. Post-completion room-by-room review with homeowner. 3-8 min per room. Identify touch-up needs, confirm satisfaction. Lead painter skill level.

factor_modifier_definitions.description: GOOD condition — sound paint, minimal prep needed
FAIR condition — localized peeling, scattered damage, moderate prep
POOR condition — extensive peeling, heavy damage, full prep needed
No contamination — baseline
Mildew contamination — biocide treatment adds time
Smoke damage — extensive TSP wash, shellac stain-blocker adds significant time
Water stain — moderate additional prep and stain-blocking primer
Grease contamination — TSP cuts grease quickly, minimal additional time
Open wall access — no obstructions, baseline
Light obstruction — some furniture remaining near walls, minor maneuvering
Heavy obstruction — significant furniture, built-ins, or fixtures limiting access
QT2 economy — reduced prep intensity, basic coverage. Per Modifier_Registry.
QT3 standard — baseline for all rates
QT4 premium — thorough prep, careful application, crisp edges
QT5 fine finish — multiple light coats, thorough inspection
Standard height 7-8ft — work from floor
Tall 9-12ft — step ladder needed
High 13-17ft — extension ladder or scaffold required
Extreme 18ft+ — scaffold or lift required, significant productivity loss
Smooth Level 4 drywall — baseline
Orange peel texture — +10% surface area, 10% slower application
Knockdown texture — +15% surface area, 15% slower. Use 1/2" nap, NOT 3/4".
Heavy texture (stomp, skip trowel) — +25% surface area, 25% slower

prep_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x contamination x access x height x texture)
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x smoke(1.5) x heavy_obstructed(1.3) x H4(2.0) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 9.75x

coating_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x height x texture)
coating_pool.max_theoretical: QT5(1.5) x heavy_obstructed(1.3) x H4(2.0) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 4.88x

round_configurations.name: Full Repaint — Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Standard full repaint for FAIR/POOR condition. Interstage after primer and after finish coat 1.

round_configurations.name: Cosmetic Refresh — No Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Most common residential repaint. Sound paint, degloss + 2 finish coats. Primer skipped when adhesion test passes.

round_configurations.name: Economy Refresh — No Prime + 1 Finish Coat
round_configurations.notes: Fastest execution path. QT2, GOOD condition, single coat. Rental turnover scenario.

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Wall spray finish at 390 SF/hr, wall backroll at 390 SF/hr — matched per NC doctrine.
coupling_constraints.notes: Identical constraint as NC wall. Spray and backroll by 2-person crew. 18-inch roller.

crew_configurations.name: Single Wall Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does wall cut-in and rolling. Most common for RP (occupied home, room-by-room).

crew_configurations.name: Wall Roller Pair
crew_configurations.notes: Cutter stays ahead of roller for larger wall areas.

crew_configurations.name: Wall Spray + Backroll Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem. Backroller sets pace.

critical_constraints.spray_only_primer_prohibited: Spray-only (no backroll) is NEVER valid for primer on previously painted surfaces. Backroll is MANDATORY for adhesion.
critical_constraints.roller_nap_warning: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown. Do NOT use 3/4" nap.
critical_constraints.no_ceiling_masking: Do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. Cut in freehand (roll) or spray into corner (spray_backroll).
critical_constraints.shellac_cleanup_warning: SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (shellac) requires denatured alcohol for tool cleanup. Water does not work.
critical_constraints.spot_prime_always: Spot prime all spackled/scraped areas regardless of whether full primer coat is applied. Prevents flashing.
